clips.title: The story
paras: Outside Ironforge’s gates in Dun Morogh, Jordan Stilwell works at his forge. He was meant for the Church of the Holy Light, but followed his father into smithing and learned from Bailor Stonehand. His craft serves paladins across the Alliance, and he forged Verigan’s Fist in honor of his old friend, Bosch Verigan.

Jordan Stilwell was expected to take holy vows and become a paladin in the Church of the Holy Light. Instead, he followed his father’s path as a smith and took up his father’s enchanted hammer. The dwarven blacksmith Bailor Stonehand helped him refine his craft. Jordan remains deeply faithful to the Light, and puts his skill to work outfitting champions who fight in its name.

Jordan once worked as a smith at the keep of Baron Silverlaine in Silverpine Forest. When Archmage Arugal unleashed feral worgen upon the fortress and turned it into Shadowfang Keep, Jordan escaped the bloodshed. He left his forge and former home behind, and eventually found refuge among the dwarves of Dun Morogh.
